name: WdAutoFitBehavior
description: Specifies how Microsoft Word resizes a table when the AutoFit feature is used.

constants.name: wdAutoFitFixed
constants.description: The table is set to a fixed size, regardless of the content, and is not automatically sized.

constants.name: wdAutoFitContent
constants.description: The table is automatically sized to fit the content contained in the table.

constants.name: wdAutoFitWindow
constants.description: The table is automatically sized to the width of the active window.
